⚓ How to use this navigator The captain’s quick guide
  1. Chart your course. Enter your question, topic, or section number. Choose all documents or a collection, then select Set sail. Search matches your words and a built-in list of related terms in the supplied documents. Related wording is labeled in results; always verify the source context.
  2. Read what you’ve found. Results show relevant source text with the document name, section or subsection when detected, and PDF page number. PDF and printed page numbers may differ.
  3. Follow the map. Select Open source PDF to check the original at the cited page, or Read full page for the extracted page text. Copy excerpt & citation copies the displayed text and its reference.
  4. Explore nearby references. Review related source sections and expand Cross references stated in this passage when available. Related keyword matches do not determine how provisions apply.
  5. Check the originals before dropping anchor. Use Source harbors for AVC’s published CBA and MOUs, and BoardDocs for APs and BPs. Verify wording, context, dates, and amendments. This tool may make mistakes or omit relevant information.

Nothing on the chart? Try fewer keywords, a specific section number, or another collection. No result does not mean a provision is absent. CBA appendix pages without extractable text remain in the PDF; AP/BP pages without extractable text are blank. This collection does not update automatically.

Reference aid only. This navigator is here to help you find information. It may make mistakes, miss relevant provisions, or show incomplete context. It does not interpret the documents or determine which provisions apply. Always check the original CBA, MOU, AP, or BP to confirm the exact wording, surrounding context, dates, and applicable amendments before relying on a result. The supplied CBA covers July 10, 2023–June 30, 2025; check AVC’s source sites for applicable documents and updates.
